ruleDefinitions.name: SQLite Firefox Profile Data DB Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect usage of the "sqlite" binary to query databases in Firefox and other Gecko-based browsers for potential data stealing.

sequences.query: ((process_product = "SQLite" OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlite\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlite3\\\.exe$"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cookies\\\.sqlite.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*places\\\.sqlite.*")))
